_doc.about: Per-(language, slug) Bible version source registry. A version bundles up to three independently-sourced channels: text, audio, timing. Only languages that need something other than the implicit default appear here; everything else resolves by fallback (see src/lib/bw/version-config.ts).
_doc.retired: Audio/timing overrides (e.g. the former 'ind' entry) are superseded by live CDN discovery — see src/lib/bw/dbt-media.ts, which reads /dbt/_app/media-index.json and /dbt/<iso>/media.json + timing/<BOOK>.json directly. That data is richer and more current than anything hand-maintained here (e.g. it found Indonesian OT audio filesets this file never declared). This file is reserved for TEXT-provider overrides only (e.g. selecting a specific translation to render as the primary reader text) — a concern the CDN media tree doesn't cover.

channels.text.provider: pkf (CDN .pkf, full coverage; optional 'collection') | helloao (needs 'id') | bsb

_doc.resolutionOrder: user selection > region override > global default > fallback (first slug) > implicit pkf
